purpose: Teach: ディベート/主体性/スパン/税額/キャスティング/特技/創意/突出

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、授業で、本気で、絶対、ディベート、絶対、取り入れてみましょうか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Sakura, let's try bringing real debate into class discussions. I think you'd thrive with it.
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Gentle conviction that she can do this. Measured pace, steady eye contact. Not pushing, but genuinely seeing her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。私の主体性、本気で、絶対、もっと、絶対、引き出していただきたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I want you to help bring out more of my own agency and ideas.
lines.style: Earnest but not performative. A small breath before she commits to the ask. Respectful of the adult but grounded in real conviction about what she needs.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 進路の検討、本気で、絶対、長いスパン、絶対、見据えましょうね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Your future path is worth thinking through carefully. Let's look at the bigger picture together.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slower pace. Not prescriptive—collaborative. Soft certainty that this matters. Trailing slightly, as if offering an open door.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。家業の税額、本気で、絶対、お父さんが、絶対、申告、絶対、しているそうです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've heard my dad handles the family business taxes and filing. I want to understand that world better.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. She's connecting two thoughts—family and ambition. Not defensive, just grounded. A hint of adult seriousness underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文化祭の劇、本気で、絶対、キャスティング、絶対、楽しみですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to the casting for the cultural festival play. That excites me.
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaking through. Faster pace here—this is something she actually wants. Still controlled, but lighter. You can hear the interest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。私の特技、本気で、絶対、絵を描くこと、絶対、なんです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Drawing is actually my real skill. It's what I'm best at.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Not bragging—just stating something true about herself. Slight firmness on 'real,' like she's claiming it fully for the first time.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文に、本気で、絶対、創意、絶対、感じられました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I could feel the creativity in your essay. It stood out.
lines.style: Direct, genuine praise. Not effusive. Warm but professional. She means this exactly—a teacher noticing and naming something real.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。クラスで、本気で、絶対、突出した、絶対、成績、絶対、目指したいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I want to aim for grades that really stand out in this class.
lines.style: Firmer than before. She's committing. Slight lean forward in her voice. Not arrogant—ambitious and grounded. Closing note: resolved.
